Monday.description_en: Italian focaccia sandwich with grilled eggplant, grilled bell peppers, fresh tomatoes, CA truffle nut paste and basil leaves.
Monday.description_is: Ítölsk focaccia samloka með grilluðu eggaldini, grillaðri papriku, ferskum tómötum, truffluhnetumauki og basillaufi.

Friday.description_en: Plant protein patties, pickled vegetables, fried tofu, spring roll, vegan stick, thin rice noodles served with sesame sauce
Friday.description_is: Plöntupróteinkökur, súrsað grænmeti, steikt tofu, vorrúlla, vegan stafur, þunnar hrísgrjónanúðlur bornar fram með sesamsósu

Thursday.description_en: Vegan volcano roll, sweet potato and avocado maki, vegan chicken katsu maki, mango and apple maki, cucumber hosomaki, mango hosomaki, iniri tofu nigiri and nigiri with marinated tomatoes.
Thursday.description_is: Vegan eldfjallarúlla, sætkartöflu- og avókadó-maki, vegan kjúklinga-maki, mangó- og epla-maki, agúrku-hosomaki, mangó-hosomaki, inari tófú nigiri og nigiri með marineruðum tómötum.

Tuesday.description_en: Vegan hamburger patty made with red beans and chickpeas with mushrooms, lettuce, tomatoes, pickled cucumber, vegan cheese and french fries.
Tuesday.description_is: Vegan hamborgarabuff úr rauðum baunum og kjúklingabaunum með sveppum, káli, tómötum, súrum gúrkum, vegan osti og frönskum.
